items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I understand that George Benson has a big exception right of as of this moment

ctx.x: I guess maybe I want someone to share the responsibility. You know, maybe that's it, because I said to Norman, I said, I know that jazz records don't sell a million to begin with -- maybe with some exceptions; I understand that George Benson has a big exception right of as of this moment -- but I would like to think if you're going to invest a lot of money in an album, I would like to hope that -- because jazz records don't sell a lot instantly, but they do sell forever.
